title: Snow
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother George.
lines.zh: 我是佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治。

lines.en: This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig. Peppa Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈。这是猪爸爸。小猪佩奇。

lines.en: Snow!
lines.zh: 下雪了！

lines.en: Peppa and George are very excited today. It is snowing outside.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治今天很兴奋。外面正在下雪。

lines.en: Mummy, can we go and play in the snow?
lines.zh: 妈妈，我们可以去玩雪吗？

lines.en: Yes, but it's very cold outside, so you must wrap up warm.
lines.zh: 是的，但是外面很冷，所以你一定要穿得暖和一些。

lines.en: Hurray!
lines.zh: 好耶！

lines.en: And don't forget to wear your hats and scarves and gloves.
lines.zh: 并且不要忘记戴上帽子、围巾和手套。

lines.en: It is very cold outside. Peppa and George must wear their hats and scarves and gloves.
lines.zh: 外面很冷。佩奇和乔治必须戴上帽子、围巾和手套。

lines.en: Come on George.
lines.zh: 来吧，乔治。

lines.en: Peppa and George are making footprints in the snow.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治正在雪地里留下脚印。

lines.en: Peppa and George love making footprints in the snow.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢在雪地里留下脚印。

lines.en: Oh dear.
lines.zh: 哦天哪。

lines.en: It's not funny.
lines.zh: 这不好笑。

lines.en: George, let's play snowballs.
lines.zh: 乔治，我们来玩雪球吧。

lines.en: Peppa has made a snowball.
lines.zh: 佩奇做了一个雪球。

lines.en: Peppa and George are having a lot of fun.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治玩得很开心。

lines.en: George, come back you little piggy!
lines.zh: 乔治，回来吧你的小猪！

lines.en: Oh dear, maybe this game is getting a little too rough.
lines.zh: 哦天哪，也许这个游戏有点太粗糙了。

lines.en: Sorry George.
lines.zh: 对不起乔治。

lines.en: George, let's build a snowman.
lines.zh: 乔治，我们来堆雪人吧。

lines.en: Peppa and George are making a snowman. First they make the body.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治正在堆雪人。首先他们制造身体。

lines.en: George, this is the snowman's body.
lines.zh: 乔治，这是雪人的身体。

lines.en: Now they make the snowman's head.
lines.zh: 现在他们开始制作雪人的头了。

lines.en: Now he needs arms and eyes and a mouth.
lines.zh: 现在他需要手臂、眼睛和嘴巴。

lines.en: George has found some sticks for the snowman's arms.
lines.zh: 乔治找到了一些用来做雪人手臂的棍子。

lines.en: Peppa has found some stones for the snowman's eyes and mouth.
lines.zh: 佩奇找到了一些石头，用来做雪人的眼睛和嘴巴。

lines.en: This is his face.
lines.zh: 这是他的脸。

lines.en: Now the snowman needs a nose.
lines.zh: 现在雪人需要一个鼻子。

lines.en: Peppa has got a carrot to make the snowman's nose.
lines.zh: 佩奇有一根胡萝卜可以做雪人的鼻子。

lines.en: The snowman looks very happy but maybe he is a bit cold.
lines.zh: 雪人看起来很高兴，但也许他有点冷。

lines.en: The snowman needs some clothes to keep him warm.
lines.zh: 雪人需要一些衣服来保暖。

lines.en: George has found some clothes to keep the snowman nice and warm.
lines.zh: 乔治找到了一些衣服来让雪人保持温暖。

lines.en: The snowman is wearing his hat and scarf and gloves.
lines.zh: 雪人戴着帽子、围巾和手套。

lines.en: Mummy, Daddy, come and look!
lines.zh: 妈妈爸爸快来看！

lines.en: Mummy Pig is wearing her hat and scarf and gloves.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈戴着帽子、围巾和手套。

lines.en: That is the best snowman I have ever seen!
lines.zh: 这是我见过的最好的雪人！

lines.en: Daddy Pig looks quite cold. He isn't wearing his hat and scarf and gloves.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸看起来很冷。他没有戴帽子、围巾和手套。

lines.en: Daddy, why aren't you wearing your hat and scarf and gloves?
lines.zh: 爸爸，你为什么不戴帽子、围巾和手套？

lines.en: I don't know where they are. I can't find them anywhere.
lines.zh: 我不知道他们在哪里。我到处都找不到他们。

lines.en: I think I know where Daddy's hat, scarf and gloves are.
lines.zh: 我想我知道爸爸的帽子、围巾和手套在哪里。

lines.en: Daddy Pig's hat and scarf and gloves are on the snowman.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸的帽子、围巾和手套都在雪人身上。

lines.en: Oh!
lines.zh: 哦！

lines.en: I want to be a nurse.
lines.zh: 我想成为一名护士。

lines.en: I want to be a doctor.
lines.zh: 我想成为一名医生。

lines.en: But who's going to be the sick person?
lines.zh: 可是谁来当病人呢？
